approvers: Owner/partner, and the developer or main contractor on the job
reason: We don't buy this today and it would mean a new budget line and a new supplier. At about 19 euro per m2 plus a 50% deposit up front, when we pay our own suppliers at 60 to 90 days, it is not worth the hassle on small house and block jobs.
objection: 50% deposit up front and 19 euro per m2 all-in, for a coating that only protects windows we can cover with cheap film or just clean afterwards. I don't see who carries the risk if it marks the frames.
instead: Keep using cheap protection film and tape and cleaning the glazing at handover, with the same trades we've used for years.
would_change_my_mind: A reference from a Maltese contractor I know, proof it costs us less than the glazing damage claims we actually have, and normal 60 day terms with no deposit.
